assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: warehouse prototype material identification image, not a real factory photograph.
Primary request: Produce a square, realistic material product render of ONE garment hang-tag string seal fastener (吊粒 / 吊牌绳), the common black braided cotton cord loop with a small rectangular black injection-molded plastic seal and a tapered snap-lock plastic end. This is NOT a cable tie, not a gun barb T-bar, not a security EAS tag, not a zipper, and not a paper clothing label. Show the long black cord as a neat oval loop across most of the frame. At lower center clearly show the small rectangular locking seal, about a centimetre long, with the narrow insertion plug just outside its socket, connected to the opposite end of the cord; make the simple snap-lock connection understandable.
Scene/backdrop: plain off-white seamless tabletop.
Style/medium: realistic clean 3D product render; visible woven cord fibers and slightly matte plastic.
Composition/framing: centered product fills around 75% of square, soft shadows, full object visible, ample margin.
Text (verbatim): a small understated Chinese caption along the bottom edge: "演示物料效果图".
Constraints: no real brand, no logo, no watermark, no paper tag, no garment, no hands, no measurement ruler, no decorative objects. The caption identifies the generated demonstration asset honestly.
